description: This file contains common shell functions used for system upgrade and installation tasks, such as installing files, handling images, and managing partitions. It includes utility functions for logging, user prompts, and interacting with hardware components.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to the target directory, handling symbolic links and creating necessary directories.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Checks if the source is executable and installs it along with its library dependencies.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Runs a series of callback functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer with a default value.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string to be JSON compatible.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the type of root filesystem mounted at /.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads and outputs the content of a source file, optionally using a compression program.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Extracts a portion of an image by piping through get_image and dd, with verbose output filtering.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads magic bytes from a file to identify file formats.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes of magic to identify image formats.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT signature from an image.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT signature from an image.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 signature from an image.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies file format based on magic bytes.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks if a partition has EFI GPT signature.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks if a partition has FAT or FAT32 signature.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Identifies and exports the device identifier where the root filesystem is located.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports the device name of a partition based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a little-endian hex string to CPU (host) endianness.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table information from a disk or file and writes it to a temporary file.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets the upgrade state indicator, invoking diagnostic script.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by flashing the image to MTD partitions, with optional backup.
